Subject: Axiom Health — Discovery recap, pain/goals & commitment timeline

Hi Marta, Evan — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our side and a proposed commitment timeline so we can align on owners and dates. Attendees listed below.

Key pain points you confirmed
- Inference latency spikes on peak traffic (esp. 300–800 token requests) causing timeouts in the triage UI.
- Cost is unpredictable across current cloud models; monthly token spend is a blocker for broader rollout.
- Embedding drift: similarity results vary between nightly and real-time pipelines.
- Data residency and auditability concerns for PHI-adjacent telemetry.

Stated goals (what success looks like)
- Median latency < 200ms for 512-token generation in production for 95% of requests.
- Predictable unit economics: target < $0.0009/token (total landed cost) for inference.
- Stable embeddings within a defined regression threshold (we'll propose eval prompts).
- Pilot deployable inside a private VPC with audit logging and KMS integration.

Proposed commitment timeline (mutual action plan draft)
1) Week 1 (Aug 6–12): Access & environment prep — exchange network requirements, service accounts, and sample dataset. Owner: Axiom — Dr. Anil Suresh; Redwood — Priyom Das.
2) Weeks 2–4 (Aug 13–31): Integration POC — model routing, KV cache tests, latency baselines. Owner: Axiom Eng (Anil) + Redwood infra (Priyom).
3) Week 5 (Sep 3–9): Quality & cost tuning — run embeddings/eval deck, quantization suggestions, batching strategy. Owner: Axiom Product + Redwood Optimize.
4) Weeks 6–9 (Sep 10–Oct 7): Procurement & legal — finalize commercial terms and SOC2 evidence. Owner: Axiom Procurement (Sarah Lee) + Redwood Legal (Vanessa Ortiz).
5) Decision target: close or extend pilot by Oct 15, 2026.

Requested confirmations / next steps
- Can you confirm owners (Anil for technical, Sarah for procurement, Marta as program sponsor) and whether the Oct 15 decision target is realistic for you?
- I'll attach the MAP workbook (Axiom-MAP-v1.xlsx) with milestones and required artifacts.
- Priyom, can you prepare a short runbook for VPC peering + sample perf tests we can hand off to Anil?

Attachments: Axiom-MAP-v1.xlsx (MAP workbook), call-recording-20260805.mp3 (recording stub)

Thanks — Jordan

1) Owners — confirm: Anil (technical), Sarah (procurement), Marta (program lead). Evan will be the clinical data liaison and will surface any PHI gating to Anil.
2) Decision target — procurement is pushing to close by Sept 30, 2026 if the POC shows latency and cost improvements; they have a quarterly review Oct 5 that would help accelerate approvals. If necessary, we can aim for Sept 30 rather than Oct 15.
3) Additional asks — procurement (Sarah) asked for our standard SOC2 + data retention answers; I've attached a short list (axiom-procurement-questions.pdf). Also, can you include a short statement on encryption-in-transit & KMS key handling in the MAP workbook?

We approve the proposed POC windows but would like the integration call with Anil + Priyom scheduled early next week (Aug 10–11). Evan — can you confirm availability?

Quick technical note and checklist for the Monday scoping call:

Minimum infra items we need from Axiom before the POC:
- VPC peering info (CIDR, peering window) or temporary bastion with egress rules to Redwood test endpoints.
- Sample query distribution (CSV) for typical 256–800 token requests + a 1k-sample embedding set.
- A test account KMS public key or KMS key reference for encryption-in-transit validation.

Perf/observability we'll run during POC:
- Continuous-batch latency baseline (p50/p95/p99) for 512 tokens.
- KV cache hit-rate targets for sessionized workloads.
- Token-level cost breakdown and per-route throttling test to reproduce spikes.

Deliverables we will produce in the POC week:
- Short VPC peering runbook (15–20m) — I will send by EOD tomorrow.
- Baseline perf report (template) after first 3 days of tests.
- Raw logs and a privacy-preserving sample of request traces.

Attachments: integration-checklist.md (inline stub)

See you Monday — I can do Mon Aug 10 at 10am PT.
